tasks.prompt: Which classes does the dropbear recipe inherit, directly and indirectly (including the ones every recipe gets)?
tasks.reference_source: bitbake: dropbear.env ($BBINCLUDED, $INHERIT); recipe and class files
facts: Direct inherits in dropbear_2025.89.bb: autotools, update-rc.d, systemd (one inherit line) and update-alternatives (a second inherit line)
autotools inherits siteinfo
Every recipe gets base.bbclass, which inherits patch, staging, mirrors, utils, utility-tasks, logging, metadata_scm (and terminal via patch)
base.bbclass also inherit_defers the toolchain classes toolchain/gcc-native and toolchain/gcc

Global INHERIT adds package_ipk (with package, packagedata, chrpath, package_pkgdata, insane), debian, devshell, sstate, license, remove-libtool, create-spdx (create-spdx-3.0, spdx-common), buildstats, uninative and sanity
wrong: dropbear inherits a class it does not (for example pkgconfig, ptest, cmake, meson)

tasks.prompt: What does curl depend on at build time in this workspace (target, machine dogbonedark), and where does each dependency come from? What would enabling its gnutls PACKAGECONFIG option add?
tasks.reference_source: bitbake: curl.env ($DEPENDS history and final value, $PACKAGECONFIG, $PACKAGECONFIG_CONFARGS); curl_8.19.0.bb
facts: libidn2, openssl and zlib come from the enabled PACKAGECONFIG options libidn, openssl and zlib (PACKAGECONFIG = basic-auth bearer-auth digest-auth ipfs negotiate-auth openssl proxy threaded-resolver verbose zlib ipv6 aws libidn)

The class dependencies: autoconf-native automake-native libtool-native libtool-cross (autotools), pkgconf-native (pkgconfig), virtual/update-alternatives (update-alternatives), and the toolchain gcc-cross-arm virtual/compilerlibs virtual/libc (base / BASEDEPENDS)
The recipe itself sets no plain DEPENDS; its DEPENDS:append:class-target adds openssl-native only with ptest enabled, which it is not here
Enabling gnutls adds gnutls to DEPENDS and passes --with-gnutls instead of --without-gnutls (PACKAGECONFIG[gnutls] = "--with-gnutls,--without-gnutls,gnutls" in curl_8.19.0.bb)
gnutls adds no runtime dependency (no fourth field) and does not by itself remove openssl
wrong: gnutls is already enabled
nghttp2, brotli, zstd, libssh2 or c-ares are current build dependencies
openssl-native is a current dependency

tasks.prompt: What does do_install of busybox consist of in this workspace, including any appends, prepends or extra functions run with it? Summarize what it does for this distro.
tasks.reference_source: bitbake: busybox.env (do_install body, $RMINITDIR, $INHERIT); busybox.inc; systemd.bbclass; remove-libtool.bbclass
facts: do_install is defined once, in openembedded-core meta/recipes-core/busybox/busybox.inc (line 225); no bbappend, no do_install:append / :prepend anywhere

It rewrites the paths in busybox.links* with sed, installs the busybox binary (busybox, or busybox.suid / busybox.nosuid) and its links / alternatives, and installs init scripts and config files (syslog, hwclock, udhcpc, ...) according to what .config enables
Its inline python conditions resolve for this distro: the systemd branch is not taken (no systemd in DISTRO_FEATURES) and busybox init is not installed (VIRTUAL-RUNTIME_init_manager is sysvinit)
systemd.bbclass adds do_install[postfuncs] ${RMINITDIR} = rm_systemd_unitdir here (systemd is not a distro feature)
remove-libtool.bbclass (from INHERIT_DISTRO) adds remove_libtool_la as a postfunc
wrong: A do_install:append or bbappend for busybox exists
The systemd units are installed for this distro
